projects.text:
1. AI Super Assistant
• Built an AI-powered automation assistant that executes real-world tasks such as food ordering, ride booking, and music playback using voice commands.
• Implemented intent detection using NVIDIA API and integrated LLM + RAG to generate step-by-step action plans.
• Developed a context-aware recommendation system to suggest food, songs, and videos based on user preferences, ratings, location, and time.
• Added predictive user behavior modeling to proactively recommend actions based on user habits.
• Implemented Android automation using Kotlin AccessibilityService to perform actions across apps automatically.

projects.text:
2. Smart Multi-Restaurant Delivery Optimization System
• Designed a multi-restaurant ordering system that allows customers to order food from multiple nearby restaurants in a single order.
• Developed a distance-based feasibility algorithm to allow orders only when restaurants are within a defined radius (0–3 km).
• Implemented route optimization logic to assign one delivery partner to pick up orders from multiple restaurants and deliver them efficiently to the same customer.
• Built a delivery time prediction model using distance, preparation time, and traffic conditions to improve delivery efficiency and reduce delivery cost.
